name: Eve
summary: The first woman, made by God from Adam's rib. She ate the forbidden fruit after the serpent tricked her, and Adam named her Eve because she was the mother of all living.

key_moments.title: Tricked by the Serpent
key_moments.description: The serpent told the woman she would not die if she ate from the forbidden tree. She saw the fruit was good to eat, ate it, and gave some to her husband.

key_moments.title: Named Eve by Adam
key_moments.description: The woman said the serpent had tricked her, and God told her she would bear children in pain. Adam named his wife Eve, for she would be the mother of every living person.

key_moments.title: Gives Birth to Cain and Abel
key_moments.description: Eve gave birth to Cain and said that with the LORD's help she had brought forth a man. Then she bore his brother Abel.
